description: Verify up to 100 visitors (IP + user-agent, optional JA4) in one call and one payment, billed per item: the same verdicts as bot_verify, for a log excerpt or a firewall review. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"items": [{"ip": "66.249.66.1", "ua": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1; +http://www.google.com/bot.html)"}]}. Returns: data: results[] (one bot_verify verdict per item, or {ip, error}), counts by verdict, billing{items, unit_price_usd}.

ip.description: The visitor's public IPv4 or IPv6 address

ja4.description: Optional TLS JA4 fingerprint, e.g. t13d1516h2_8daaf6152771_02713d6af862

ua.description: The User-Agent header it sent (omit or empty if none)

name: bot_verify_batch
title: Crawler identity check (batch)
